accessibility.reduceMotion: Replace movement with a crossfade, single luminance change, and VoiceOver announcement.
accessibility.voiceOver: Announce the primary unlock and summarize all included rewards once.
accessibility.silentMode: Never override silent mode or seize the audio session.
accessibility.dismissal: Every reveal is immediately dismissible and remains visible later in the Vault history.
